## Change

Describe the software or documentation change and its purpose.

## Verification

List the checks actually run, their results and any checks not run. Use synthetic inputs.

## Compatibility

Identify changes to record semantics, command behavior, dependencies or operation.

## Contribution review

- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under the project’s contribution terms.
- [ ] Relevant source and third-party notices are identified and retained.
- [ ] The change preserves evidence, stable identities and architectural authority boundaries.
- [ ] The submission and its outputs contain no credentials, private source records or personal information.

See CONTRIBUTING.md, GOVERNANCE.md and SECURITY.md.
